name: SIM Groups Bridge
description: Test fixture for the pairs/teams bridges: a team-split's groups reused as a pairwise collect's pairs (reusePairsFrom), then a pair-scoped reveal, then a merge adopting the same groups (groupsFrom). Underscore-prefixed so it never appears in game lists. Driven by scripts/simulate-groups-bridge.js.

share.prompt: Tell your partner one thing you are looking forward to this week.

write.instruction: Combine your two answers into one shared sentence.

items: Read your shared sentence out loud

end.message: Same partners the whole way through.
